message.content:
Here are some **free online auto repair estimate** tools you can use:

- **RepairPal** — free car repair estimates based on your zip code, vehicle, parts, and labor; also shows guaranteed prices for 30 days.[2]
- **YourMechanic** — instant free estimates with parts-and-labor breakdowns for many repair and maintenance services.[1]
- **AAA** — provides repair cost estimates with parts, labor, and member discount details; you enter year, make, model, trim, engine, and zip code.[4]
- **Kelley Blue Book (KBB)** — free auto repair pricing and fair repair ranges for common repairs and maintenance.[7]
- **NAPA Auto Care** — free repair estimates for common repairs and routine maintenance; notes that final quotes require an inspection at a NAPA Auto Care center.[3]
- **Caliber** — free initial online estimates for auto body, collision, and glass repair.[5]
- **Openbay** — lets you describe the issue, compare quotes from local repair professionals, and book online.[6]

If you want, I can also help you pick the **best option for your specific repair** such as brakes, alternator, AC, collision damage, or diagnostic trouble codes.
